title: A Word for the Weary
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler who is brave in a quiet way, and tonight is about trusting in the dark: Isaiah walks with no light and trusts the name of the Lord, and Beau, when the hallway bulb burns out, does not call out but whispers to Heavenly Father until his breathing slows.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because trusting in the dark takes quiet courage. In Beau’s world today: the hallway light burned out right at bedtime. Beau’s chest went tight, but he did not call out. He whispered to Heavenly Father and held his blanket until his breathing slowed. Just like Isaiah, who walked without light and trusted anyway, Beau learned that Heavenly Father stays close when we cannot see.
